posts.title: Just a Passing Phase
posts.description: Today, a close friend mentioned I seemed down. I asked if that seemed unusual. They said yes. At work, no one's noticed. Working from home makes it easy to keep things separated. I can show up for calls, focus, and help people out. But by late afternoon, the tank is empty. Right now, I’m sitting in the library where I’ve spent the day. posts.title: On Second Thoughts
posts.description: Even in middle age, I still catch myself doing post-mortems every time I speak in public. I don’t spiral the way I did when I was younger, but the quiet second-guessing remains: Did I say the right thing? At the right moment? In a way that people in the room understood?
